data.name: Monesh
data.gender_notes: Monesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Mona’ meaning moon and ‘Ish’ meaning god. This name is associated with the Hindu god, Shiva, who is often depicted with a crescent moon on his forehead. The name Monesh carries the meaning “Moon, God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Monesh usually hope their child will grow to embody moon, god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Monesh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moon, God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Monesh total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

It brings to mind the significance of the moon in the Hindu pantheon and its association with deities such as Ganesha and Shiva. Monesh is a name that instantly evokes images of sacred ceremonies, particularly during the night or during lunar months.
data.spiritual_significance: With its Sanskrit roots, Monesh holds a deep spiritual significance. The name invokes the power and grace of the god Shiva, who is the embodiment of divine consciousness, unity, and transformation. It is a name that inspires a sense of reverence, hope, and devotion. Monesh is a name that touches the soul and embodies the purest of spiritual aspirations.
